_readme: Edit this file to keep posts accurate. Gemini is only allowed to use the facts written here. A person is spotlighted only when 'speciality' is filled in and 'spotlight' is not false. A department is posted only when it has at least one doctor or a 'brief'. Images go in social-images/ (see social-images/README.md). Source: Drive sheet 'CHETNA HOSPITAL DOCTORS' (Jan 2026) and chetnahospital.co.in (Dr. Hemant C. Patil).

hospital.name: Chetna Hospital
facts: Multispeciality hospital in Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune
19-bedded ICU, including 6 dedicated cardiac ICU beds
CT scan, MRI, sonography and dialysis available in the hospital

topics.label: 24x7 Emergency
topics.brief: Our emergency department is open 24x7. Tell people what to do in an emergency and that they can reach us any time.

topics.label: Health check-up packages
topics.brief: Encourage preventive health check-ups. Do not quote prices unless they are listed in the facts.

topics.label: About Chetna Hospital
topics.brief: Introduce the hospital: multispeciality care in Pimpri Chinchwad with a team of experienced doctors.

departments.name: General Surgery
departments.brief: Surgical care for common general surgical conditions.

departments.name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
departments.brief: Pregnancy care, delivery and women's health.

departments.name: Orthopaedics & Spine
departments.brief: Bone, joint and spine problems, including spine surgery, joint replacement and foot and ankle surgery.

departments.name: Ophthalmology (Eye Care)
departments.brief: Eye care, including cataract and phaco refractive surgery.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.brief: Skin, hair and nail care, including dermato-surgery.

departments.name: Cardiology
departments.brief: Heart care: consultations, diagnosis and treatment of heart conditions, including 2D echo, stress test and interventional cardiology.

departments.name: Critical Care
departments.brief: Intensive care for critically ill patients in a 19-bedded ICU with 6 dedicated cardiac ICU beds.

departments.name: Interventional Radiology
departments.brief: Image-guided, minimally invasive vascular and non-vascular procedures.

departments.name: Dental Care
departments.brief: Dental care, including aesthetic and cosmetic dentistry.
